record.original_question: Let D be a domain in C (containing the origin) of connectivity n, and let S(D) be the class of analytic univalent functions in D with f (0) = 0, f ′ (0) = 1. Find the functions f in S(D) that minimise Z Z |f ′ (z)|2 dσz . D (D. Aharonov)

evidence.quote: Let D be a domain in C (containing the origin) of connectivity n, and let S(D) be the class of analytic univalent functions in D with f (0) = 0, f ′ (0) = 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D \subset \mathbb{C}$ be a domain of finite connectivity $n$ that contains the origin. Denote by $S(D)$ the class of functions $f: D \to \mathbb{C}$ that are analytic and univalent in $D$ and satisfy the normalization $f(0)=0$ and $f'(0)=1$. Determine all functions $f \in S(D)$ that minimize the area functional
$$\iint_D |f'(z)|^2\, d\sigma_z,$$
where $d\sigma_z$ denotes the planar Lebesgue area measure. In particular, characterize the extremal functions and the corresponding minimum value as a function of $D$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not surface a definitive resolution of this minimal-area problem for the class of normalized univalent functions on a general domain of connectivity n. Related minimal-area problems for univalent functions on the unit disk (notably by Aharonov and Shapiro) have been studied, but no source directly establishing the extremal function for arbitrary multiply-connected D was located.

status_evidence.title: A minimal area problem in conformal mapping
status_evidence.snippet: Minimal area problem for normalized univalent functions; addresses related extremal problems on the unit disk.
status_evidence.claim: Related minimal-area extremal problems for normalized univalent functions have been studied, but the multiply-connected version is not explicitly resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Univalence Criteria in Multiply-Connected Domains
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Aharonov's invariants and univalence in multiply-connected domains.
status_evidence.claim: Work on univalent functions in multiply-connected domains exists, but the specific area-minimization problem is not shown solved.
